ns2:section.sectionText: Sapora Symposium 2021 is a Professional Development symposium featuring high profile professionals who will address contemporary issues related to entrepreneurism and applied leadership within the context of Recreation, Sport, and Tourism Industries. This is an ASYNCHRONOUS online course using Illinois Compass for all course instruction and interaction. You will receive an email from the instructor with specific directives. Synchronous course option available. Please see Course Catalog for information.
